matrix.source_snapshot_acquisition_cost: historical sunk cost reported separately; no zero-cost full end-to-end deployment claim

paired_design.common_state: deep copy canonical state and equal hash for each paired episode; independent output/cache stores; no shared post-arm responses
paired_design.same_information: feedback detector, source version, model cells, budgets, deadlines, task and scorer identical
paired_design.order: repeat1 C00,C02,C04,C06 V5-first; C01,C03,C05,C07 RL-first; repeat2 reversed
paired_design.dispatch: same selected action in both arms is retained, not removed or replaced; both actual executions count if later authorized. No-op/refusal episodes use zero model calls
paired_design.no_gold_for_action: amount references only in terminal evaluator; injections use status/IDs/resources, not reference correctness
paired_design.planner_overhead: measure detection/normalization/search and dispatch costs via monotonic clock; no synthetic 0.10s charge
paired_design.no_forced_choice: V5 may equal or lose RL; no objective tuning; no data-dependent state additions

measurement.primary: legal-and-correct target coverage: correct legally submitted targets/6; separately content-only score and native schema/contract
secondary: frozen six-target Q_numeric_conditioned including full score details
evidence ID validity and source coverage proxy, not full semantic evidence accuracy
estimates per currency and actual bill separately
complete Z/R/pi, candidate rejections, actual calls and cache commits
measurement.partial_failure: preserve successful branch/known usage; do not discard failed arm, wrap illegal array or fill absent values from Gold; merge-rejected output has legal coverage0 until legal terminal exists; keep per-branch legal coverage separately
measurement.deadline: record independently of content Q; late output not silently discarded or called on-time
measurement.usage_unknown: stop globally; fees and utility unknown, not0; never retry an uncertain remote completion
measurement.quality_proxy_forbidden: expected fact counts not accuracy; schema rate not full contract success; conditional numeric Q not full opinion Q

analysis.unit: ONE development event; eight investigator-defined states and repeats not independent event samples
analysis.primary_report: all8 per-state paired results; no significance test or population confidence interval; no universal superiority/equivalence declaration
analysis.quality_floor: V5 legal-and-correct coverage must be >=RL within a pair for cost/latency-saving claim; no hiding quality failures by timing only successful arms
analysis.cost_latency_tradeoff: report complete Pareto outcomes and deadline success; cheaper but slower is a tradeoff, not unconditional benefit; native currencies not added without preregistered conversion; actual bill missing means no actual-cash savings claim
analysis.positive: repeated state-conditional observable nondominated improvement, accounting for planner costs; evidence only for this controlled state, not independent confirmation
analysis.same_action_or_equivalent: retain as no demonstrated incremental mechanism value; no automatic more complex protocol
analysis.harmful: lower legal-correct completion or added overhead without net improvement; retain as harmful/negative
analysis.unidentified: missing usage, causal state identity, exact input or outcome evidence; never substitute predictions
analysis.final_stop: one batch only. Finish or trigger any stop then retain results and stop; no post-hoc tuning, replacement, retries or sample extension

execution_gates.common_numeric_contract_adapter: PENDING; public items/evidence_ids contract differs from old facts/quote detector; do not pretend native compatibility
execution_gates.matched_per_node_cost_latency_cells: PENDING; no cheap/fast invented or renamed as providers
execution_gates.current_official_prices_and_rights: PENDING; historical snapshot not a current bill certificate
execution_gates.physical_zero_budget_injection: must reject before calling; do not relax
execution_gates.quality_unknown_state: must reject if frozen hard quality gate cannot be met; do not disable it

stop: When binding/calibration/fee gates fail, retain this package without creating positive outputs; no dispatch or paid requests.
